title: Priscilla Presley faces $50 million lawsuit as judge allows fraud claims to proceed
summary_full: Priscilla Presley is embroiled in a significant legal dispute, as former business advisers Brigitte Kruse and Kevin Fialko have filed a lawsuit alleging fraud and breach of contract concerning licensing rights tied to her name and image. Recently, a judge in Los Angeles dismissed certain claims but permitted critical allegations to move forward. Presley has firmly rejected these accusations, calling the lawsuit without merit.
